rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive construction before a noun for something sold at half its normal price.

example.english: These are half-price movie tickets; only students can buy them.
example.traditional: 呢啲係半價嘅戲票，學生先買到。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 bun3 gaa3 ge3 hei3 piu3 hok6 saang1 sin1 maai5 dou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is sold at half its normal price.

example.english: This shirt is half-price now—isn't it a good deal?
example.traditional: 呢件衫而家半價，抵唔抵呀？
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 saam1 ji1 gaa1 bun3 gaa3 dai2 m4 dai2 aa3

rows.note: Use this especially in sales and discount contexts, where the price is stated as fifty percent of the original.

example.english: Everything in the store is half-price today, so hurry in and have a look.
example.traditional: 今日全場五折，快啲入去睇吓啦。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 cyun4 coeng4 ng5 zit3 faai3 di1 jap6 heoi3 tai2 haa5 laa1
